title: 名词：可数/不可数
definition: 可数名词有单复数形式；不可数名词没有复数。

title: 名词：复数规则
definition: 英语名词复数的六条规则。

title: 人称代词
definition: 主格作主语, 宾格作宾语。

title: 物主代词
definition: 形物代后接名词, 名物代独立用。
tips: 形物+名词, 名物独立站

title: 冠词：定冠词 the
definition: 特指某人某物。独一、序数、最高、乐器前。

rules.note: I saw a dog. The dog...

examples.en: The cat is under the chair.

commonErrors.wrong: The book is in the desk.

examples.en: He was late because he missed the bus.
I go to school every day.

title: 一般过去时(规则)
tips: 一般ed, e加d, 辅y变i加ed

title: 过去进行时
definition: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作。

title: 一般将来时 be going to
definition: be going to+原形, 表打算或预测。

rules.note: I will help you. vs I am going to study.

examples.en: I am going to study hard.

title: 现在完成时(1)
definition: have/has+过去分词。过去对现在的影响。

rules.note: I had finished before he arrived.

title: 现在完成进行时
definition: have been doing 从过去持续到现在。

title: 过去时 vs 完成时
definition: 有具体时间用过去, 无时间影响现在用完成。

rules.rule: 完成: 无时间或持续

title: 情态动词 must/have to
definition: must主观(必须), have to客观(不得不)。

examples.en: I have to get up early.

title: 情态动词 may/might
definition: may表许可/可能, might更不确定。
tips: May I... 问许可, might表可能

title: 情态动词 would/could
definition: would委婉请求, could礼貌询问。

title: 不定式 to do
definition: to+原形作目的状语或宾语。

rules.note: I go to school to study.

examples.en: He wants to be a doctor.

rules.note: I saw him cross the road.
I saw him crossing the road.

title: 陈述句
definition: 肯定句:主语+谓语。否定句:主语+don't/doesn't/didn't+谓语。
tips: 肯定正常说, 否定加not

title: 一般疑问句
definition: 将be/助/情态动词提前。Yes/No回答。

examples.en: Are you OK? Yes, I am.
Do you like music? No, I don't.

title: 特殊疑问句
definition: What, Who, Where, When, Why, How提问。

rules.note: Do you like tea or coffee?

title: 反意疑问句
definition: 前肯后否, 前否后肯。

rules.rule: 肯+否: It's nice, isn't it?
否+肯: You don't like it, do you?

examples.en: It's a nice day, isn't it?

commonErrors.wrong: You are a student, isn't you?
commonErrors.correct: You are a student, aren't you?

tips: 前肯后否, 代词对应

title: 祈使句
definition: 动词原形开头, 无主语。否定: Don't+原形。
tips: 原形开头下命令, Don't否定拦路

title: 感叹句 What/How
tips: What接名How接形, 感叹句中有区别

examples.en: There is a cat on the chair.

title: There be 句型(2)
definition: There be的过去时和将来时。

title: 主谓一致(1)
definition: 主语和谓语在人称和数上一致。

examples.en: Either you or he is wrong.
I like music. So does she.
examples.cn: 我喜欢音乐, 她也一样。

examples.en: I can't swim. Neither can he.
examples.cn: 我不会游, 他也不会。

rules.note: It was Tom who broke it.

examples.en: It was yesterday that I met him.
It is she who helps me.

title: 并列句
definition: 两个简单句用并列连词连接。

rules.note: I like apples, and she likes bananas.

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed.

title: 复合句概述
definition: 主句+从句。从句有主语+谓语。

rules.note: I know that he is right.

examples.en: I think that she is smart.
When it rains, I stay home.

tips: 主句统领, 从句补充

title: 宾语从句(1): that

examples.en: She said that she was tired.

tips: that可省略, 从句正常语序

rules.note: I wonder if he will come.

examples.en: I don't know if she likes it.
He asked whether I could swim.

commonErrors.wrong: I don't know that if he comes.
commonErrors.correct: I don't know if he comes.

title: 宾语从句(3): wh-词

commonErrors.wrong: I know what do you want.

tips: 从句语序: 疑问词+主+谓

title: 定语从句(1): 关系代词

examples.en: The girl who is singing is my sister.
The book which I read was great.

title: 定语从句(2): 关系副词

rules.note: the place where I was born

examples.en: I remember the day when we first met.
examples.cn: 我记得我们初见的那天。

examples.en: This is the school where I studied.

title: 状语从句: 时间

rules.note: When I arrived... / While I was...
I will wait until you come.

examples.en: When it rains, I stay home.

tips: 时间状语: 动作的钟表

title: 状语从句: 条件

rules.note: If it rains, I will stay.
Unless you hurry, you will be late.

examples.en: If you study hard, you will pass.
Unless it rains, we will go.
examples.cn: 除非下雨, 我们会去。

commonErrors.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay.
commonErrors.correct: If it rains, I will stay.

tips: 主将从现: if后用现在时

title: 状语从句: 原因/目的/结果
definition: because原因, so that目的, so...that结果。

rules.note: so tired that I fell asleep

examples.en: I stayed home because it rained.
He is so tired that he can't walk.

title: 被动语态(1): 一般现在/过去
definition: be+过去分词。主语是动作承受者。

rules.note: The book is read by many.

examples.en: The classroom is cleaned every day.
The letter was written by Tom.

tips: 被动: be+过分, by引出施动者

title: 被动语态(2): 含情态动词

examples.en: The work should be finished today.

title: 被动语态(3): 完成/将来

rules.rule: 现在完成: have/has been done

examples.en: The meeting will be held tomorrow.

tips: 时态变在前, 被动结构跟在后

title: 主动 vs 被动
definition: 主动强调施动者, 被动强调承受者。

rules.rule: 主动→被动: 宾变主, 加be+过分
rules.note: Tom wrote the letter → The letter was written by Tom.

examples.en: The letter was written by Tom. (被动)

tips: 主动强调谁做的, 被动强调被怎样

title: used to do
definition: used to do过去常常。be used to doing习惯于。

rules.note: I am used to getting up early.

examples.en: I used to live in Beijing.
I am used to the weather.

tips: used to do过去常, be used to doing习惯

title: It is + adj + to do

rules.note: It is important for you to study.
It is kind of you to help.

examples.en: It is important to learn English.
It is kind of you to say so.

tips: It + is + adj + to do, 形式主语开头站

examples.en: He is so tall that he can reach it.
It is such a good book that I read it twice.

title: 直接引语→间接引语
definition: 转述别人的话, 时态向后退一步。

examples.en: He said, 'I am happy.' → He said he was happy.

commonErrors.note: 主句过去, 从句时态后退

tips: 时态后退, 人称相应变

title: 条件句: if+现在, will
definition: 真实条件: if+一般现在, 主句will+原形。

rules.rule: If it rains, I will stay.
rules.note: 条件从句永远用现在时

examples.en: If it is sunny, we will go to the park.
examples.cn: 如果天晴我们就去公园。

commonErrors.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay.
commonErrors.correct: If it rains, I will stay.

tips: 主将从现: if从句永远现在时

title: 祈使句+and/or
definition: 祈使句+and/or+陈述句(表条件结果)。

rules.note: Work hard and you will succeed.
Hurry up or you will be late.

examples.en: Study hard and you will pass.
Hurry up or you will be late.
